app.title: Cast Trim Upload
app.in_progress_empty: Episodes you prepare show up here. You can listen to each one and upload it when it sounds right.

form.title: New episode
form.intro: Paste a link, choose the part to keep, and fill in the details for Spotify. Fields marked <req>*</req> are required.
form.length_hint: Episode length: {{length}}. Only this part is downloaded.
form.footer_hint: You can listen to the audio before it goes to Spotify.
form.toast_preparing: Preparing audio. Follow the progress on the right.
form.toast_artwork_failed: Artwork not saved: {{error}}. You can add it again before uploading.

artwork.label: Episode artwork
artwork.hint: Optional. Square JPG or PNG, at least {{min}}×{{min}} px. Without it, Spotify uses the show cover.

validation.url_required: Paste a YouTube or Twitch VOD link
validation.url_invalid: Not a YouTube video or Twitch VOD link
validation.end_after_start: Must be after the start time
validation.end_past_video: Past the end of the video
validation.number_positive: Must be a whole number of 1 or more
validation.explicit_required: Choose whether the episode is explicit
validation.artwork_type: Use a JPG or PNG image
validation.artwork_too_big: Image must be {{mb}} MB or smaller
validation.artwork_not_square: Image must be square (this one is {{w}}×{{h}})
validation.artwork_too_small: Image must be at least {{min}}×{{min}} px

job.login_title: Log in to Spotify for Creators
job.login_body: A browser window opened. Log in there; the upload continues on its own. Closing that window cancels the upload.
job.audio_hint: MP3 320 kbps · {{length}}. Listen to the start and the end to check the cut.
job.confirm_discard: Discard this episode and delete its temporary files?

history.title: History
history.description: Episodes uploaded or discarded from this computer.

spotify.login_opening: A browser window is opening. Log in to Spotify for Creators there.
spotify.login_success: Logged in to Spotify for Creators

tools.offline_body: Start it with start.bat, or run cast-trim-upload in a terminal.
tools.missing_body: Missing: {{tools}}. Run cast-trim-upload setup and restart the app.
tools.js_runtime: a JavaScript runtime (Node.js or Deno) for YouTube

progress.downloading_section: Downloading the section and encoding MP3
progress.downloading_full: Section download unavailable, downloading the full audio
progress.waiting_upload: Waiting for another upload to finish
progress.login_required: Log in to Spotify for Creators in the browser window that just opened
progress.uploaded_draft: Saved as a draft on Spotify

error.interrupted: Interrupted when the app was closed. Retry to start again.
error.cannot_edit_details: Episode details can't be changed now
error.audio_not_ready: The audio is not ready to upload
error.schedule_in_past: The scheduled publish date is in the past. Edit it first.
error.only_failed_retry: Only failed episodes can be retried
error.wait_for_upload: Wait for the upload to finish or fail (closing the login window cancels it)
error.tool_missing: {{tool}} is not installed. Run: cast-trim-upload setup
error.no_file: yt-dlp finished but produced no file
error.duration_mismatch: The audio is {{actual}} s long, expected {{expected}} s. Check that the end time is within the video.
error.probe_failed: Could not read the video info: {{detail}}
error.unsupported_url: Unsupported link. Paste a YouTube video or a Twitch VOD link (twitch.tv/videos/…).
error.spotify_busy: The Spotify browser is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.spotify_not_loaded: Spotify for Creators did not load (stuck at {{url}})
error.login_window_closed: The login window was closed before logging in
error.login_timeout: Timed out waiting for the Spotify login
error.upload_step_failed: The Spotify upload failed at the "{{step_key}}" step: {{detail}}
error.upload_step_failed_screenshot: The Spotify upload failed at the "{{step_key}}" step: {{detail}} (screenshot: {{screenshot}})
error.field_missing: {{field_key}} field not found on the Spotify form
error.calendar_day_missing: Could not find {{date}} in the Spotify calendar
error.wizard_stuck: Spotify did not leave the episode wizard after submitting
